item.title: Sim Lian’s Rivelle Tampines EC draws over 8,000 visitors during preview weekend
item.description: The preview of Sim Lian Group’s Rivelle Tampines executive condominium (EC) drew more than 8,000 visitors since the sales gallery opened on Friday, March 6, the developer said at 10pm on Sunday, March 8. The strong turnout comes ahead of the e-application period, which runs until March 16, with sales booking scheduled for March 21. item.title: Lendlease’s Tony Lombardo to join Frasers Property as group COO
item.description: Tony Lombardo, the group CEO of Australian developer Lendlease Group, will be joining Frasers Property as group COO. In a March 9 announcement, Frasers Property says Lombardo’s appointment will take effect on Oct 1. Based in Singapore, he will report to Frasers Property's group CEO Panote Sirivadhanabhakdi. item.title: OKP lands $87.3 mil contract to build Jurong Region Line’s commuter infrastructure
item.description: Singapore infrastructure and civil engineering firm OKP Holdings has secured a contract worth $87.3 million from the Land Transport Authority (LTA) for commuter infrastructure works around upcoming stations on the Jurong Region Line. The 60-month contract commenced on Feb 27. Under this contract, OKP’s wholly-owned subsidiary, Or Kim Peow Contractors, will design and construct covered linkways around the stations, along with new cycling paths and footpaths. item.description: Real estate investments in Asia Pacific (Apac) are poised for a broad-based recovery in 2026, amid improving market clarity, stabilising conditions and renewed investor engagement, says Colliers. item.title: Penthouse at Aman Residences Dubai sold for AED422 mil, despite regional tensions
item.description: A penthouse at Aman Residences Dubai, a luxury residential development in the Jumeirah Peninsula in the UAE, was sold for AED422 million ($147 million) on March 5, transaction data published by the Dubai Land Department shows. The unit, which measures 2,898 sq m (31,194 sq ft), is a six-bedroom property. According to Gulf News, the property was sold off-plan and marks the third most expensive apartment ever sold in Dubai. item.title: Strata office floor at Southpoint for sale at $20.5 mil
item.description: A unit comprising an entire floor at Southpoint, a freehold office building at 200 Cantonment Road, is up for sale via an expression of interest (EOI) exercise. Spanning a strata area of 6,415 sq ft, the floor has a guide price of $20.5 million, which translates to $3,196 psf. CBRE, which is handling the sale, says the unit is on a high floor and features sea views, along with an efficient, column-free layout with a floor-to-slab ceiling height of approximately 3.4m. item.title: Singapore real estate giants feel the heat as China's property woes continue
item.description: Singapore’s real estate giants are taking hits as China’s property downturn drags into another year, with declining rents, emptier buildings and falling values weighing on their results. But analysts say Beijing’s huge market and recent policy support mean most investors are unlikely to pull back entirely, instead becoming far more selective about where they invest.
